headline: Sri Lanka reached 404-4 at the close of day three of the first Test against Pakistan in Rawalpindi on Wednesday, 30 runs behind Pakistan's 434-9 declared, with Dhananjaya de Silva 167 not out and Kusal Mendis 117 not out, Dawn (AFP) reports.

card.desc: Pakistan ke 434-9 se Sri Lanka sirf 30 runs peeche.

caption:
Rawalpindi Test mein Sri Lanka ka zordar jawab, 404-4! 🏏
Dawn (AFP) ke mutabiq Wednesday ko pehle Test ke teesre din Sri Lanka ne 4 wickets par 404 runs banaye. Dhananjaya de Silva 167 aur Kusal Mendis 117 runs par not out hain. Dono ne panchvein wicket ke liye 249 runs ki partnership ki, jo Pakistan ke khilaf Sri Lanka ka record hai. Sri Lanka ab Pakistan ke 434-9 (declare) se sirf 30 runs peeche hai. Kam roshni ki wajah se khel 15 minute pehle khatam hua.
Kya Pakistan ke bowlers kal wapsi kar payenge? Comment mein batayein 👇
